== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster uses whether the opponent initiated a battle. It replaces the random card selection and choice of destination with optional retrieval of 1 Force and drops the later relocation action. Both retain loss for movement away and the controlling battleground conditions.
